title: Wild Hamster Has A Graveyard Feast | Seven Worlds, One Planet | BBC Earth

segments.description: Medium close-up shot of a wild European hamster peeking out from behind memorial candle jars in a cemetery [[00:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkZ6gzyg7yY&t=1)].
Medium tracking shot of the hamster scurrying quickly along stone pathways and through grass [[00:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkZ6gzyg7yY&t=17)].
Wide establishing shot of the quiet cemetery grounds filled with gravestones and floral arrangements [[00:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkZ6gzyg7yY&t=38)].
Medium close-up shot of the hamster navigating cautiously past colorful memorial candles [[01:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkZ6gzyg7yY&t=60)].
Close-up action shot of the hamster nibbling on white funeral flowers left on a grave [[01:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkZ6gzyg7yY&t=75)].
Medium action shot of the hamster reaching inside a red candle jar to feast on leftover wax [[01:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkZ6gzyg7yY&t=96)].
Close-up shot of the hamster stuffing its oversized cheeks with high-calorie candle wax [[01:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkZ6gzyg7yY&t=119)].
Medium humorous shot of the hamster getting its stuffed head stuck in the candle jar before freeing itself and scampering away [[02:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkZ6gzyg7yY&t=142)].
